name: Maria G.
headline: Co-Founder @ Neru - Scaling DME and Sleep Health | Harvard | CDTM & TUM

positions.title: Co-founder & CTO
positions.description:
Neru is the patient operations layer for DME healthcare.

We help providers reduce operational leakage across intake, adherence, troubleshooting, and resupply. Neru improves patient outcomes while protecting revenue and lowering cost-to-serve.

Through Nora, our clinician-trained AI operating system, patients receive continuous support beyond setup, and care teams are extended (not replaced) so they can focus on high-value human touch clinical work. The result: stronger Medicare compliance, higher retention, fewer exceptions, and the ability to scale without increasing headcount.

We work with leading regional and national DMEs to unify fragmented workflows, connect signals across the patient lifecycle, and make growth operationally sustainable.

From intake to long-term care, Neru ensures no patient falls through the cracks.

positions.title: Graduate Research Fellow
positions.description: At the Systems Genetics and Machine Learning Lab (Prof. Paolo Casale) at Helmholtz AI for Health, I worked on machine learning for clinical and digital biomarkers to predict neurodegenerative, cardiovascular, and sleep disorders years before onset. My research contributed to PRiMeR, published in Genomics Research - a deep learning framework that combines genetic, clinical and digital data for early disease detection and biomarker discovery.
